Button.TooltipReference: This opens the reward window to allow you to preview the reward(s) for this task.
Select a Monster Mission and click this button to open the monster selection window.
Select a Task and click this button to abandon it.
Target a player and click this button to add them to your shared task.
Select a player and click this button to remove them from your shared task.
Select a player and click this button to make them the leader of your shared task.
Invite anyone who is in your raid but not in your shared task.
Invite anyone who is in your expedition but not in your shared task.
